🥟 The CASOFU Burrito Blanket — Wrapped in Warmth

The CASOFU Burrito Tortilla Throw Blanket has become a viral sensation for good reason. At 285 GSM (grams per square meter), the flannel fabric is noticeably denser and plusher than most novelty blankets. It actually feels like a quality throw you'd want on your couch every day — not just a novelty you pull out when guests come over.

The 60-inch square shape is a huge practical advantage. You can fold it, drape it over your shoulders, wrap yourself up burrito-style for a photo op, or use it as a proper couch blanket. The double-sided tortilla design means it looks convincingly like a giant flour tortilla from both sides — perfect for those "I'm a burrito" photos that keep going viral.

Key things we loved:

  • The fabric genuinely feels soft, not scratchy like some fleece throws
  • Washes well — we ran it through a gentle cycle and it came out like new
  • Versatile size means it works for both kids and adults
  • Fun without sacrificing utility — you'll actually use this as a blanket

🍕 The Calhoun Pizza Blanket — A Slice of Fun

The Calhoun Ultra-Realistic Pizza Throw Blanket takes a different approach. Instead of wrapping yourself up, you get a giant 60-inch round pizza slice complete with pepperoni, melted cheese, and a stitched-edge crust border. It's unquestionably the more photogenic of the two — lay this across your couch and it looks like someone dropped an extra-large pizza on it.

However, the round shape is where form triumphs over function. As an actual blanket, it's harder to use — you can't really wrap it around yourself the way you can a square blanket. It's best used as a decorative throw or a lap blanket for movie night on the couch. The polyester fleece is soft enough but noticeably lighter than the burrito blanket's flannel (roughly 200 GSM vs 285 GSM).

Where it shines:

  • The ultra-realistic print is genuinely impressive — guests will do a double-take
  • Lightweight material makes it a good summer throw
  • Game-day parties and pizza-themed events are a perfect match
  • The stitched crust edge adds a nice touch of craftsmanship

🎯 When to Choose Which

Choose the CASOFU Burrito Blanket if:

  • You want a blanket that's actually cozy and usable every day
  • You're looking for a gag gift that won't end up in the back of a closet
  • You prefer a square shape for wrapping around yourself
  • You want thicker, warmer material (perfect for winter)

Choose the Calhoun Pizza Blanket if:

  • You're decorating a dorm room, game room, or man cave
  • The visual impact matters more than daily coziness
  • You're buying for a die-hard pizza fan
  • You want something lightweight for warmer months
🏆 WORTH IT GOODS PICK

CASOFU Burrito Tortilla Throw Blanket

While both blankets are hilarious and well-made, the CASOFU Burrito Blanket wins because it doesn't sacrifice function for fun. The 285 GSM flannel is genuinely cozy, the square shape is infinitely more practical for daily use, and the double-sided tortilla design means the novelty doesn't wear off. You get a conversation starter and a quality blanket in one.

The Calhoun Pizza Blanket is a fantastic decorative piece — if you need a showstopper for a game room or pizza-themed party, it's the clear choice. But for an everyday cozy blanket that also happens to be hilarious, the burrito takes the win.

💡 Quick Summary

Both the CASOFU Burrito Tortilla Throw Blanket ($20.99) and the Calhoun Pizza Throw Blanket ($19.99) are excellent novelty gifts at nearly identical price points. The difference comes down to how you plan to use it:

  • Best Overall Blanket: CASOFU Burrito — thicker, softer, square shape, more versatile
  • Best Decorative Piece: Calhoun Pizza — more photogenic, ultra-realistic print
  • Best Gag Gift: Tie — both are crowd-pleasers at white elephant exchanges
  • Best for Snuggling: CASOFU Burrito — the flannel fabric is noticeably plusher

Either way, you're getting a smile and a blanket — can't really lose with that combination. 🎉
